notes: Account snapshot: large enterprise dev tools company building a unified internal code search + RAG platform used by 1200+ engineers.
Primary ask: scale embeddings corpus (~120M vectors currently) with frequent re-indexing (daily incremental + weekly full), low tail latency on retrieval and a second-stage reranker (cross-encoder).
Workloads: first-pass ANN retrieval (HNSW/IVF) to fetch top-K, then cross-encoder rerank for top-10 -> must keep total end-to-end <= 300ms p95 for developer hot-path queries.

Performance targets discussed on 2026-02-18 call: 500 QPS sustained for search endpoint, spike to 2k QPS for internal release, cost target approx <$0.01 per query (embeddings + rerank), and 95th percentile end-to-end latency <300ms.
POC scope: ingest 30M subset of repo + docs for first benchmark, run embedding + rerank pipeline, compare Redwood Dedicated (quantized variants) vs customer's current CPU-hosted solution.

Model preferences: open to Llama2 / Falcon variants for generative rerank, prefer Redwood-verified embedding models with 1536-2048 dims; strong interest in mixed-precision quantized models to reduce cost.
Routing/fallback requirements: prefer multi-tier routing - low-latency GPU pool for hot queries, cheaper batch pool for bulk re-runs; auto-fallback to smaller reranker on capacity pressure.

Data & compliance: strict SSO/SAML mandatory, SCIM provisioning desired; retention policies (90d ephemeral + 7y audit logs), KMS integration required, data residency: US-EAST primary with EU satellite for EU teams.

Indexing notes: current indexing pipeline re-builds full index weekly (6-8 hours) and daily incremental (30-45 min). They want incremental latency <15 min from commit to indexed availability. Also ask for snapshot / fast rollback for bad ingest batches.

Cost levers: interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions (dynamic batching, prefix caching, quantization profiles) to hit per-query cost target. Mentioned desire for token-level cost breakdowns in Console.
